newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK external trade value by sea up 2.2 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: HK external trade value by sea up 2.2 pct in 1996.

text.p: The value of Hong Kong's external trade by sea was HK$1.419 trillion in 1996, up 2.2 percent from 1995, the Census and Statistics department said on Tuesday.
Trade by sea accounted for 48 percent of total external trade value in 1996, it said.
Value of trade by land rose 4.4 percent to HK$752.8 billion, accounting for 26 percent. Air transport trade rose 3.5 percent to HK$593.8 billion, accounting for 20 percent.
